description: Upgrade a host from 0.4.0 to the 0.5.0 candidate and roll it back to 0.4.0 and 0.3.0, on one state: 0.4.0's unit carries the three old mutation and mode settings, 0.5.0's only --allow-mutations (D55). Between them the 0.5.0 binary runs under the old unit, and 0.4.0 is tried alone under the new one.

inputs.agent: the 0.5.0 candidate's release binary (the one the dev VM runs), started by the journey with `serve` and explicit settings
inputs.previous: the previous Rust releases, 0.4.0 (${PARITY}/e2e/release/rust-0.4.0-rc6) and 0.3.0 (${PARITY}/e2e/release/rust-0.3.0-rc9), copied in

requirements.requirement: No mutation setting other than the flag

pass.equals: Error: mutation refused: ensure_host_file has effect mutation; the bearer token is read-only on this agent. Start the agent with --allow-mutations, or use an OAuth client granted the mutate scope.

requirements.scenario: A leftover setting: the 0.5.0 binary under the 0.4.0 unit, whose OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS, OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS and OPUTE_AGENT_MODE grant nothing, serves 0.4.0's state with a read-only bearer, and nothing it prints names them
Upgrade from 0.4.0 to 0.5.0 with the 0.5.0 unit: it serves at the same address on the same state, and --allow-mutations admits the bearer's mutations

requirements.requirement: Rollback restores the previous release's unit with its binary

pass.equals:
flag provided but not defined: -allow-mutations
exit=1

requirements.scenario: 0.4.0 put back alone under the 0.5.0 unit exits on --allow-mutations before serving; with 0.4.0's unit back, 0.4.0 and then 0.3.0 serve 0.5.0's state, 0.5.0's work included, and admit mutations from that unit's settings

requirements.requirement: Every orchestrator is an ordinary client
requirements.scenario: An orchestrator's machine client listed in OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS keeps its generated credential, and gets a working token, across the upgrade and both rollbacks

steps.guest: install -d -o opute -g opute /tmp/e2e-agents /tmp/e2e-agents/roll /tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home && systemd-run --quiet --collect --unit=e2e-agent-roll --uid=opute --gid=opute --property=Restart=no --setenv='HOME=/tmp/e2e-agents/roll/home' --setenv='OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID=e2e-roll' --setenv='MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:roll}' --setenv='HOST_MCP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0' --setenv='HOST_MCP_PORT=3004' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_INSTANCE=platform' --setenv='OPUTE_OAUTH_CLIENTS=opute-mcp-host' --setenv='OPUTE_AGENT_MODE=standalone' --setenv='OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' --setenv='OPUTE_HOST_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true' /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust-0.4.x/opute-host-agent serve && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3004/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3004/health
